e.title: Application Fill 投保单自动填写：每条答案都带着来源文件、归因、置信度、推理与变换一起走，并把「95% 成功」标注为「客户反馈、不是字段准确率基准」
e.title_en: Application Fill, automated insurance application completion: every answer travels with its source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation, and the reported 95% success is labelled as customer feedback rather than a field-accuracy benchmark
e.title_hk: Application Fill 投保單自動填寫：每條答案都帶著來源文件、歸因、置信度、推理與變換一起走，並把「95% 成功」標註為「客戶反饋、不是字段準確率基準」
e.summary: 一个把经纪人手上已有的资料自动填进保险公司投保单的工具：输入是一份已完成的投保单或一批提交文件，输出是保留原表单样式且仍可编辑的已填 PDF，凡是填进去的字段都带着字段级溯源与人工复核流程；作者自述其为经纪业务而建、已卖给经纪公司并是自用最多的工具之一；其证据表最值得记——每一行都有一个「范围」列，写明这个数字**不是**什么：「95% 成功」被标注为「客户反馈、由作者报告，不是字段准确率基准，样本量与标准化的成功定义都不在此列出」；「ACORD 表单 100% 准确」被标注为「由作者报告」且「本仓库不主张对每一份 ACORD 表单或专业险种表单都达到 100%」；专业险种那批的字段级指标「衡量的是与经纪实务成功率不同的人群与结果」；字段级溯源逐字为「来源文件、归因、置信度、推理与变换随每条答案一起走，而经纪人修改保留其自身的取值与编辑元数据」；评测纪律逐字含答案要点、关键字段计分、误填检查、空白段检查、来源缺口诊断与回归门
e.summary_hk: 一個把經紀人手上已有的資料自動填進保險公司投保單的工具：輸入是一份已完成的投保單或一批提交文件，輸出是保留原表單樣式且仍可編輯的已填 PDF，凡是填進去的字段都帶著字段級溯源與人工覆核流程；作者自述其為經紀業務而建、已賣給經紀公司並是自用最多的工具之一；其證據表最值得記——每一行都有一個「範圍」列，寫明這個數字**不是**什麼：「95% 成功」被標註為「客戶反饋、由作者報告，不是字段準確率基準，樣本量與標準化的成功定義都不在此列出」；「ACORD 表單 100% 準確」被標註為「由作者報告」且「本倉庫不主張對每一份 ACORD 表單或專業險種表單都達到 100%」；專業險種那批的字段級指標「衡量的是與經紀實務成功率不同的人群與結果」；字段級溯源逐字為「來源文件、歸因、置信度、推理與變換隨每條答案一起走，而經紀人修改保留其自身的取值與編輯元數據」；評測紀律逐字含答案要點、關鍵字段計分、誤填檢查、空白段檢查、來源缺口診斷與回歸門
e.summary_en: A tool that fills insurer application forms from information brokers already hold: the input is one completed application or a set of submission documents and the output is a filled PDF that preserves the original form and remains editable, with field-level provenance and a broker review workflow attached to everything that gets filled in; the author states it was built for brokerage work, sold into brokerages and used as one of his most-used tools; the most notable part is its evidence table, where every row carries a scope column stating what the number is not — the 95% success figure is labelled as customer feedback reported by the author rather than a field-accuracy benchmark, with sample size and a standardised success definition not included; the 100% accuracy on evaluated ACORD forms is labelled as author-reported, with the repository explicitly not claiming 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application; the specialty field-level metrics are said to measure a different population and outcome from brokerage-reported practical success; field-level provenance is described verbatim as source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation travelling with each answer, with broker edits retaining their own value and edit metadata; and its evaluation discipline includes answer keys, critical-field scoring, false-fill checks, blank-section checks, source-gap diagnostics and regression gates
e.body:
**application-fill-provenance**（Application Fill，仓库 `maebied23/application-fill`）**是一个把保险经纪人手上已有的资料自动填进保险公司投保单的工具**：**实测 ★1、fork 数未核实、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 259 KB、创建于 2026-09-09、最后推送 2026-09-09、无 topics**（**⚠️ 本条元数据来自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽**——**见标注 ①**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 183 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 10,343 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 183 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Insurance applications completed from the information brokers already have.** … Application Fill turns a completed application or a collection of submission documents into filled insurance PDFs, **with field-level provenance and a broker review workflow**.」**；**并逐字说明来历**：**「**I built this for brokerage work, sold it into brokerages, and used it as one of my most-used tools.** Customer brokerages reported a **95% success rate** when supplying submission documents or one completed application.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「每个值都要指回它的来源」**中的**第一种，也是四条里唯一**被商业化使用过**的一条**——**其溯源颗粒度是**字段级**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其证据表是本条最值得记的一处，因为每一行都有一个**范围**列，写明这个数字**不是**什么**——**逐字实测**：**「Brokerage experience | **95% reported success** … | **Customer feedback reported by the author; not a field-accuracy benchmark. Sample size and a standardized success definition are not included here.**」**；**「Initial ACORD testing | **100% accuracy reported by the author on evaluated ACORD forms** | **Evaluation records will be added later. This repository does not claim 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application.**」**；**「Specialty expansion | … | **Their field-level metrics measure a different population and outcome from brokerage-reported practical success.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三行各拒绝一种过度解读**：**① **「95% 成功」被限定为**客户反馈、由作者报告**，**并明说不是字段准确率基准**，**且**样本量与标准化的成功定义都不在此列出****；**② **「100% 准确」被限定为**由作者报告**，**且**明确不主张对每一份 ACORD 表单或专业险种表单都达到 100%****（**⭐ 并逐字注明「评估记录将在稍后补充」——**即**这个数字当前没有可查的评估记录**）；**③ **专业险种那批的字段级指标**衡量的是**不同的人群与结果****（**⭐ 即**不许把两批数字混着引用**）**⭐⭐⭐ **本词条认为这是本站已收条目里**把「一个数字的适用范围」写得最清楚的一张表****——**它不删掉好看的数字，而是**在每个数字旁边写明它不能用在什么地方****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这三个数字本身**——**见标注 ③**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其字段级溯源逐字，且它点名了随每条答案走的**五项****——**逐字为**：**「**Field-level provenance: source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation travel with each answer. Broker edits retain their own value and edit metadata.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **五项逐一对应一个会被问到的问题**：**① **来源文件**（**哪个文件**）；**② **归因**（**文件的哪一处**）；**③ **置信度**（**有多确定**）；**④ **推理**（**为什么这么判**）；**⑤ **变换**（**做了哪些运算或改写**）**——**⭐ 而最后半句「经纪人修改保留其自身的取值与编辑元数据」是**同样重要**的一环：**人工改过的答案**不覆盖机器判断的痕迹，**而是**另有一套元数据****（**⭐ 对本轮主题而言，这保证的是**机器值与人改值各自的来处都不丢****）。**③ ⭐⭐ **其六步经纪人流程逐字，其中三步与溯源和可核对性直接相关**：**「**Review answers beside the PDF.** Select field overlays, filter flagged or unfilled answers, **inspect confidence and reasoning, and open source documents from attribution.**」**；**「**Edit and approve export.** Save broker corrections **with audit events** and regenerate the PDF.」**；**「**Finalize and download.** Generate the final artifact from current answers, **record its hash** and export statistics, and **obtain a signed download URL.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **在 PDF 旁边就能**从归因打开来源文件****——**⭐ 即**复核动作与证据在同一屏内完成**；**② **经纪人修改**记录审计事件****；**③ **最终产物**记录其哈希**——**⭐ 即**输出的那一份是可被指认的**（**与第 338 轮 [[amanat-telegraph-miner]] 的签名、[[claimscope-benchmark]] 的数据钉定同属一族**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「评测纪律」逐字列出了七项，是一份可直接借用的词汇表**——**逐字为**：**「**Evaluation discipline:** answer keys, **critical-field scoring**, **false-fill checks**, **blank-section checks**, **source-gap diagnostics**, cached/full pipeline modes and **regression gates**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **七项中四项值得单独记**：**① **关键字段计分**（**即**不是所有字段等权，**有些字段填错代价不同**）；**② **误填检查**（**⭐ 即**专门检查「不该填的被填了」**，**而不只是「该填的填了没」**——**与本站在第 337 轮 [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] 记录的「两个方向都查」同源**）；**③ **空白段检查**；**④ **来源缺口诊断**（**⭐ 即**专门定位「源文件里没有这个信息」的情形**，**从而把「填不出」与「填错」分开**）**⭐⭐ **对做表单抽取的同学，这四项比一个总准确率更有用**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其混合匹配的分工逐字，且给出了清晰的边界**——**逐字为**：**「**Hybrid matching:** AI identifies relevant facts and transformations; **code applies arithmetic, section gating, constraints and reuse checks**. **Deterministic spreadsheet parsing handles recognized schedules, with an AI fallback.**」**⭐⭐ **即**人工智能负责「找出相关事实与变换」，**代码负责「算术、分段门控、约束与复用检查」****——**⭐ 而确定性解析用于已识别的表格、AI 作为兜底**（**⭐ 这是本轮四条里唯一明确划出「哪一层由谁负责」的一条**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其 PDF 工程细节逐字，说明它不是提示词包装**：**「real AcroForm discovery; coordinates and widget-to-page mapping; **nearby text enrichment for generic field names**; text, checkbox, radio and choice filling; **font sizing and overflow handling**」**⭐⭐ **其中两处值得记**：**① **对泛化字段名做邻近文本增强**（**⭐ 因为 PDF 表单里的字段名常常是 `Text1`、`Field_23` 这类无意义标识，**其含义只能从**旁边的印刷文字**读出**）；**② **字号与溢出处理**（**⭐ 即**填进去的字要放得下**——**这是表单类工具真实会遇到而说明文档常忽略的一步**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其多文档路径与架构逐字**：**支持**已完成的投保单、PDF 保单与损失清单、Excel 明细表与 Word 文档****；**文本提取优先，OCR 依赖的路径用 LlamaParse**；**实测 `docs/` 下六份文档**（**`ARCHITECTURE.md`、`EVALUATION.md`、`EXTRACTION.md`、`FEATURES.md`、`SETUP.md`、**`VALIDATION.md`**）**，**另有 `docs/evidence/` 目录且其下**按表单族分子目录**（**实测含 `docs/evidence/acord/README.md`**），**以及三份清单类产物**（**`docs/extraction-manifest.json`、`docs/package-manifest.json`、**`docs/specialty-baseline.json`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **`docs/evidence/` 按表单族分目录**——**⭐ 即**证据是**按险种／表单类型**组织的，**而不是堆在一个文件夹里****；**② **`specialty-baseline.json` 是一份**基线快照**——**⭐ 即**「之前是多少」被存了下来，**故**后续变化可以对比****；**③ **两份 manifest**（**抽取物与包**）**。**⑧ ⭐ **其自述的一个起点也值得记**：**「Development first established strong performance on **ACORD forms**, then expanded into specialty applications through **progressively harder test cases**.」**——**⭐ 即**从标准表单（ACORD）做起，再逐步加难****（**⭐ 而它逐字承认这批更难的用例「帮助暴露了版面歧义、源信息缺失与聚合错误」**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站表单标准、文档抽取与复核工作流条目并读**：[[acord]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[suture-vlm]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]、[[underwriting-workbench]]、[[proof-protocol]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本条的元数据来源需要说明**：**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽（实测 0/60）**，**故 ★数（1）、主语言（TypeScript）、体量（259 KB）与创建／推送日期（均为 2026-09-09）来自**搜索 API**（**其返回完整的仓库对象**）**；**⚠️ 本词条**未取得其 fork 数与 topics****（**⚠️ 属**本轮未核实**项，**而**不是**「无 topics**」**——**与本站其他条目对 topics 的写法不同，特此注明**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为**无****——**`LICENSE` 在 183 个条目中实测不存在**，**README 亦无许可章节**，**属「完全未声明」形态**；**⚠️ 本词条据此提示：**复制、修改或再分发其代码、文档与清单前应先向作者确认授权****；**⭐ 并特别提示：它自述**曾卖给经纪公司**——**故其代码与业务逻辑的权属可能受商业安排约束**，**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**它可被任何人自由复用**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其任何证据数字**——**⚠️ 包括「95% 客户报告成功率」「ACORD 表单 100% 准确」与专业险种那批的字段级指标**；**⚠️ 本次**未读 `docs/EVALUATION.md`、未读 `docs/evidence/acord/` 下任何内容、未读 `docs/specialty-baseline.json`、未运行任何评测****；**⭐ 尤其**未核实其「100% 准确」所依据的评估记录是否已经存在****（**⚠️ 其 README 逐字说「Evaluation records will be added later」，**即**在本次核实时点该记录**尚未提供**——**本词条**不主张**该数字有任何可查依据**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **本词条**有意不把「95%」与「100%」写进摘要的显著位置**——**⭐ 理由**：**其证据表的价值恰在于**给这两个数字加了范围限定**，**而**把数字单独摘出来**正好会丢掉这个限定****（**⚠️ 本词条据此建议读者**以范围列而不是数字本身**来判断其成熟度**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、未运行任何命令****——**⚠️ 故**字段级溯源的五项、混合匹配的分工、PDF 工程细节、六步流程与七项评测纪律**全部只记录为 README 如此声明****；**⭐ 本词条**已实测的只是**相关文件确实存在****（**`docs/` 下六份文档、`docs/evidence/acord/README.md`、三份 JSON 清单、`src/lib/ai/`、`package.json`、`.github/workflows/checks.yml`**）**——**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等于其中的逻辑与门槛如文档所述**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**。**⑥ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据（**来自搜索 API**）、README（10,343 字节）全文、以及仓库全部 183 个条目的文件清单**；**⚠️ 本次通读了 README 的**开篇与来历、证据表、经纪人六步流程、「实现上有意思的地方」七条、架构图与架构段落开头****；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Node、未运行任何命令、**未读任何源码、未读 `docs/` 下任何文档内容、未读 `docs/evidence/` 下任何内容、未读任何 JSON 清单、未打开任何界面****。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核实**其与任何经纪公司、保险公司或 ACORD 的关系**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**它被任何具名机构采用、已上线运营或已产生任何实际的投保单产出**；**⭐ 其 ACORD 是**保险行业标准表单**（**本次未查 ACORD 标准本身**，**故**不转述任何表单结构或字段定义**）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其字段级溯源满足任何审计、合规或监管要求**——**⚠️ 本次**未查任何监管对投保单填写或留痕的要求****；**亦**不主张**其可用于代替经纪人的专业判断**（**⭐ 其自述逐字为「keeping the broker in control」与「Human review」，**即**定位是辅助而非替代**）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其处理的数据是否涉及真实个人信息**，**亦**未核实**其数据留存与隐私做法**（**⚠️ 本次**未读其 `docs/SECURITY.md`**——**⚠️ 该文件**不在本仓库**：**实测 `docs/SECURITY.md` 属**同作者的另一个仓库**，**本仓库的 `docs/` 下六份文档中不含此文件**——**此处如实说明，以免混淆**）。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其做法（字段级溯源、误填检查、来源缺口诊断）适用于本站读者所在场景的任何具体表单**——**只记录其设计与自述理由**。**⑪ ⭐ ★1、创建与推送均为 2026-09-09**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⚠️ 但须同时写明：**其自述**已卖给经纪公司并在实务中使用**——**⚠️ 本词条**不核实**该说法**（**本次未查任何商业记录或客户评价**），**故**既不主张其为真，也不主张其为假**。**⑫ **README 为英语**——**本词条已如实记入，**本次未核实是否有其他语言版本**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/maebied23/application-fill` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取**时**配额已耗尽（返回 rate limit 错误）**，**故 ★数／语言／体量／创建推送时间改用**搜索 API** 的值，**且**未能取得 fork 数与 topics****；README 10,343 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**仓库全部 183 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**用于确认 `docs/` 下六份文档、`docs/evidence/acord/README.md`、三份 JSON 清单、`src/lib/ai/`、`package.json` 与 `.github/workflows/checks.yml` 均存在，且**不存在 `LICENSE`**）；**未克隆、未安装 Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its evidence table is the most notable part, because every row carries a scope column stating what the number is *not*** — **measured verbatim**: **"Brokerage experience | **95% reported success** … | **Customer feedback reported by the author; not a field-accuracy benchmark. Sample size and a standardized success definition are not included here.**"**; **"Initial ACORD testing | **100% accuracy reported by the author on evaluated ACORD forms** | **Evaluation records will be added later. Broker edits retain their own value and edit metadata.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **each of the five answers a question someone will ask — source document (which file), attribution (where in it), confidence (how sure), reasoning (why judged so), transformation (what arithmetic or rewriting was applied)** — ⭐ **and the final clause matters as much: a broker edit does not overwrite the trace of the machine judgement but carries its own metadata, so the origin of both the machine value and the human value is kept**. **③ ⭐⭐ Its six-step broker workflow is verbatim, and three steps bear directly on provenance and checkability**: **"**Review answers beside the PDF.** … **inspect confidence and reasoning, and open source documents from attribution.**"**; **"**Edit and approve export.** Save broker corrections **with audit events** …"**; **"**Finalize and download.** … **record its hash** and export statistics, and **obtain a signed download URL.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things: the source document can be opened from the attribution right beside the PDF, so review and evidence happen on one screen**; **broker corrections are saved with audit events**; **and the final artefact records its hash — the delivered copy is identifiable** (**the same family as round 338’s [[amanat-telegraph-miner]] signature and [[claimscope-benchmark]]’s pinned data**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its evaluation discipline lists seven items verbatim**: **"answer keys, **critical-field scoring**, **false-fill checks**, **blank-section checks**, **source-gap diagnostics**, cached/full pipeline modes and **regression gates**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four deserve separate note**: **critical-field scoring, so not all fields weigh the same**; **false-fill checks, which specifically look at what should not have been filled rather than only at what should have been** (**the same instinct as round 337’s [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] checking both directions**); **blank-section checks**; **and source-gap diagnostics, which separate "cannot be filled" from "filled wrongly"**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its hybrid-matching division of labour is verbatim**: **"AI identifies relevant facts and transformations; **code applies arithmetic, section gating, constraints and reuse checks**. **Deterministic spreadsheet parsing handles recognized schedules, with an AI fallback.**"** ⭐⭐ **AI finds the facts and transformations; code does the arithmetic, section gating, constraints and reuse checks**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its PDF engineering detail is verbatim**: **"real AcroForm discovery; coordinates and widget-to-page mapping; **nearby text enrichment for generic field names**; … **font sizing and overflow handling**"** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: **nearby-text enrichment for generic field names, because PDF form field names are often meaningless identifiers like `Text1` whose meaning can only be read from the printed wording beside them**; **and font sizing with overflow handling — the text has to fit**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its document paths and measured structure**: **completed applications, PDF policies and loss runs, Excel schedules and Word documents**; **six documents measurably present under `docs/`** (**ARCHITECTURE, EVALUATION, EXTRACTION, FEATURES, SETUP and **VALIDATION**), **plus `docs/evidence/` with subdirectories per form family** (**`docs/evidence/acord/README.md` is measurably present**), **and three manifest-type artefacts** (**`extraction-manifest.json`, `package-manifest.json` and **`specialty-baseline.json`**) ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **evidence is organised per form family rather than piled into one folder**; **and `specialty-baseline.json` is a baseline snapshot, so "what it was before" is kept for later comparison**. **⑧ ⭐ Its starting point is verbatim**: **"Development first established strong performance on **ACORD forms**, then expanded into specialty applications through **progressively harder test cases**."** — ⭐ **start on the standard form, then add difficulty**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s form-standard, document-extraction and review-workflow entries**: [[acord]], [[acord-data-quality-monitor]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[suture-vlm]], [[claims-intake-agent]], [[underwriting-workbench]], [[proof-protocol]] and [[insurance-qa-en]].
